About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.

text:
March of Giants | Official Premiere – Pioneer Playtest
March of Giants is gearing up for war! Join us October 7 for an exclusive look at the game, what's coming next, and how you can play. Set your reminder now!

March of Giants is a free-to-play 4v4 MOBA where you lead an army, not just a hero. Play as a towering Giant, rally hundreds of Soldiers, and deploy Battleworks that turn familiar lanes into shifting front lines. Master your abilities, lead your army, reshape the battlefield, and take your team to victory.
 
Join the Pioneer Playtest on Steam [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924600/March_of_Giants/]

#Ubisoft #MarchofGiants

About Ubisoft:

Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. With a Ubisoft+ subscription, players can access new releases, premium editions and extra content on Day One on PC, console and cloud. ABOUT TRACKMANIA
Welcome to Trackmania — the unique racing game that combines precision and creativity. 

Trackmania® offers a unique, easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay experience with a wide diversity of tracks across five stunning environment (Red Island, Blue Bay, Green Coast, White Shore, and Stadium) along with regular content updates and live events:
- Face new racing challenges with Weekly Shorts and Weekly Grands, a new season every three months, and more player-made tracks featured in the “Track of the Day” selection.
- Compete online in Daily and Weekly Cups, Grand Enduro races, as well as in community-driven and worldwide esports events.

About Ubisoft: 
Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences.
